preconditions.description: Number of glades is between 1 and 10^6.
Number of trails is between 0 and 10^6.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= xi <= n and 1 <= yi <= n for xi, yi in trails)
preconditions.description: Each trail connects glades within the range [1, n].

postconditions.expression: return_value == 0 if is_eulerian_trail(n, trails) else min_additional_trails(n, trails)
postconditions.description: If an Eulerian trail exists, return 0; otherwise, return the minimum number of additional trails needed.
